# Chirag Mirani

> Chirag Mirani is a data scientist and quantitative researcher in Suwanee, Georgia, with about 20 years in quantitative finance and a Master of Science in Computational Finance from Carnegie Mellon University. He builds predictive models and forecasting systems across macro, options, volatility, time series and prediction markets, competes on Kaggle, and ships iPhone and iPad apps. Projects below are public and free to read.

## About
- Role: data scientist and quantitative researcher. Open to data science and quantitative research roles.
- Skills: Python, time series forecasting, machine learning, reinforcement learning, options and volatility modeling, macroeconomic forecasting, prediction-market modeling, backtesting.
- Evidence of work: a live US macro forecast dashboard with a public track record against Kalshi and actual releases; a published paper on exposure-adjusted strategy evaluation; Kaggle silver-medal notebook and a top 22% finish (379 of 1,711 teams) in the MITSUI Commodity Prediction Challenge.
- Current research: reinforcement learning and ARC-AGI-2 reasoning benchmarks (ARC Prize 2026).
- Profiles: GitHub https://github.com/ChiragMirani, LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/in/chiragmirani/, Kaggle https://www.kaggle.com/cmirani, SSRN https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=6292699

## Apps and readers
- [Shree Hanuman Chalisa (English)](https://chiragmirani.github.io/hanuman-chalisa/): the Hanuman Chalisa verse by verse in plain English, with the Hindi (Devanagari), the Hindi in English letters and Gujarati letters; all 43 verses, offline. Free iPhone and iPad app, Shree Hanuman Chalisa English, no ads and no data collected: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6819752072
- [Through the Ring PRO](https://chiragmirani.github.io/through-the-ring/): a free-to-try one-tap arcade game for iPhone and iPad: 3 free runs, then one optional one-time $2.99 (US) unlock for unlimited runs. No ads, no subscription, no tracking, and no internet needed to play. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id1203310957. Details: https://chiragmirani.github.io/through-the-ring/llms.txt
- [Vocabula: K-12 Vocabulary](https://chiragmirani.github.io/vocabula-pages/app/): vocabulary flashcards for iPhone and iPad, 4,241 cards in English, Math and Science, Kindergarten through Grade 12. Works offline, no ads, nothing collected. Free download; one $4.99 in-app unlock. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/vocabula-k-12-vocabulary/id6819035983
- [Compound Interest Calculators](https://chiragmirani.github.io/chip-compound-calculator/) (subtitle "Chip: Savings Plans & Goals"; formerly Chip Compound Interest): an offline compound interest calculator for iPhone and iPad with growth charts, side-by-side plan comparison, goal solving and PDF/CSV reports. $2.99 paid once; no ads, subscriptions or in-app purchases. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6822411872. Details: https://chiragmirani.github.io/chip-compound-calculator/llms.txt
- [Series 65 Exam Practice Tests](https://chiragmirani.github.io/series65/): 1,211 practice questions and 1,143 flashcards for the Series 65 exam, every answer explained, for iPhone and iPad. Free download with a 10-question test and 10 flashcards; one payment unlocks everything, no subscription ($19.99 in the US). App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6812059689. Details: https://chiragmirani.github.io/series65/llms.txt
- [Practice Combination Lock](https://chiragmirani.github.io/locklab/): an offline trainer for three-number rotary combination locks (0–39 dial) for iPhone and iPad, with Watch, Learn and Practice modes for the right-left-right sequence. All features free; optional one-time tips unlock nothing. No ads, subscriptions, account or tracking. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id6822015018
- [Practice Combination Lock details](https://chiragmirani.github.io/locklab/llms.txt)
- [VocabDeck](https://chiragmirani.github.io/zoes-vocabulary/): free K-12 vocabulary flashcards (English, Math and Science) on the web, and a free iPhone and iPad app with no account, no ads and no internet needed. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6761394575
- Coming soon to the App Store (submitted, not yet live):
  - [Chip Mortgage Calculator](https://chiragmirani.github.io/chip-mortgage-calculator/). Details: https://chiragmirani.github.io/chip-mortgage-calculator/llms.txt
  - [MCAT Prep: Mini Practice Tests](https://chiragmirani.github.io/mcat-mini/): four-question practice mini-tests across the four MCAT sections, with an explanation after every answer, for iPhone. Details: https://chiragmirani.github.io/mcat-mini/llms.txt
- [Gita](https://chiragmirani.github.io/gita-quotes/): all 700 verses of the Bhagavad Gita in English.
- [The Vedas reader](https://chiragmirani.github.io/vedas/) and [The Upanishads reader](https://chiragmirani.github.io/upanishads/).
